content:
When vscode-plugin.html bridge receives clickedOnDiagram_ideEvent message:
1. Listen for 'clickedOnDiagram_ideEvent' in IdeConnect.input_loadDiagramFromFile
2. Extract jsonContent, filename, filePath from event.data
3. Call this.app.handleLlmJsonPaste(jsonContent, filename, filePath)
4. This will load nodes and display filename
